name: Panama
dossier:
The Panama national football team, affectionately known to their passionate supporters as the La Marea Roja, enter the FIFA World Cup 2026 with high expectations. Currently ranked number 34 in the world, they bring a unique tactical identity and style from CONCACAF to this expanded 48-team tournament.

Tiny nation, massive belief  -  the romantics of Group L.

With the tournament co-hosted across the United States, Mexico, and Canada, Panama will count on their travelling support to create a vibrant atmosphere. Their primary objective will be to make a statement in Group L and navigate their way to the high-stakes knockout rounds.
whatToWatch: Keep a close eye on their transition play in Group L. The connection between Adalberto Carrasquilla and José Fajardo is crucial to their attacking spark.
xFactor: Adalberto Carrasquilla - the clinical midfield who holds the ability to turn a match on its head with a single moment of magic.
verdict: Panama are poised to be one of the most intriguing stories of the group stage, bringing great energy to the tournament.
funFacts: Panama's first-ever World Cup goal in 2018 was treated as a national holiday back home.
Panama boast 0 World Cup titles in their historical cabinet, with their best tournament finish being Group stage (2018).
